The risk score for this record is 0.5370. This score is in the middle range. It means there is some risk, but it is not the highest level. A score of 0.0 means no risk, while 1.0 means the highest risk.

The column that contributed most to this risk is age. In this case, age decreases the risk. This is important because knowing someone's age can help narrow down who they are. If other details are known, it can make it easier to guess their identity.

To lower the risk, better anonymization of age is needed. One way to do this is to group ages into ranges, like 20-30 or 30-40. This way, it is less clear who someone is based on their age alone. Making these changes can help protect privacy better.

Risk scores represent ML model confidence under simulated attack conditions, not real-world re-identification probability.
